queries: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id) SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share_of_all_accounts FROM district_counts ORDER BY share_of_all_accounts DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share_of_all_accounts FROM account GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY share_of_all_accounts DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10;
